### DOC-SKILL-008: Changelog-Style Summary

- Integrated a bounded fixed-model mini documentation-skill path for seven approved mini skills.
- Operator prompt now offers selection between Codex and OpenRouter for eligible mini documentation tasks.
- Runner reports actual OR cost upon completion when telemetry is accepted.
- A seven-skill live batch completed with validation_result=PASS for all accepted rows.
- The 5.4 candidate phase remains planning-only, beginning with fixture preparation.
- No production routing was enabled.
- No canonical routing-table update was made.
- Auto Router remains experiment-only.
- The 5.4 phase has not run live OR evaluations yet.
